items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: And Johan Horlen, who is the lead alto player in the WDR Big band, he is a very strong clarinetist so he’s happy to play the clarinet parts.

ctx.x: I assume that gig required some doubling and were you prepared for that?

Yes. Yes I was prepared for that. In Diva also we played a lot of doubles and I played a lot of gigs in New York with various big bands. And I realized that doubling is so crucial. You just don’t get called for these kind of bands if you don’t have your flute and clarinet together. And clarinet is not my favorite instrument but on the flute I feel comfortable so that is definitely my stronger double and in the WDR Big Band even though all of us play all the doubles, each one of us has stronger doubles and things…

That reminds me of a conversation I just had with a couple of the top lead trumpet players in Los Angeles and they said that, that sometimes — well there’s a part here and you know what you’d be a lot better on it so “pass it on” they would say.
